title: The S8 prereg freezes harness-sha and explains its 70 of 73 screened units
body:
Source: S8 readiness audit 2026-11-19 (lead session); ADR 0021 points 10-11.
Evidence: evals/replay/abc.prereg.md has no harness-sha: line (matrixProblems at evals/replay/abc.ts:186 blocks the report); prereg lists 70 units, the screen 73, without stating the 3 exclusions.
Outcome: the prereg names the three excluded units with their reason and, at freeze, the harness-sha; a check refuses a confirmatory run whose prereg lacks either.
Proof: node evals/replay/run.ts --prereg evals/replay/abc.prereg.md --report --strict names no prereg problem after the freeze.
